title: The Book of Knowledge - The Keys of Enoch
author: J. J. Hurtak
description: The Book of Knowledge: The Keys of Enoch by James J. Hurtak (Academy for Future Science, first published 1977), one of the most influential modern channelled scriptures. Hurtak states that its 64 'Keys' were given to him in 1973 by the Masters Enoch and Metatron during an experience of being taken into higher realms. The keys combine biblical prophecy, Kabbalah, Hebrew divine names, astronomy, genetics and physics into a cosmology of a 'Brotherhood of Light', a hierarchy of intelligences (the Elohim and Merkabah), the role of Orion and the Pleiades, the transformation of human DNA and consciousness, and an approaching planetary transition. Dense with neologisms and diagrams, it helped popularise ideas such as the Merkabah light-body and the sacred-name chant 'Kodoish, Kodoish, Kodoish Adonai Tsebayoth' in New Age culture.
